market.question: No change in Reserve Bank of Australia's interest rates at the November 2026 meeting?

en.title: RBA Rate Hike Expectations Surge
en.summary: The probability of no RBA interest rate change in November 2026 plummeted 31.5% to 36%, driven by JPMorgan economists' forecast of widespread global central bank rate hikes. This shift reflects growing expectations that the RBA will follow other major developed markets in increasing rates by year-end.
drivers: JPMorgan economists forecast eight of nine major central banks to hike rates by year-end 2026.
Elevated inflation keeps pressure on ECB and Fed to raise interest rates.
Global central bank tightening sentiment reduces RBA 'no change' likelihood.
en.why_matters: RBA's decision impacts Australian economic growth, inflation, and household borrowing costs. It also signals Australia's alignment with global monetary policy trends.
en.bull_case: Australian inflation significantly cools by November 2026, allowing the RBA to maintain current interest rates despite global pressures.
en.bear_case: Persistent elevated inflation in Australia forces the RBA to hike rates, aligning with global central bank actions.

en.title: Pipeline Restart Hopes Plummet Post-Attack
en.summary: The probability of the Saudi East-West oil pipeline restarting by September 15 plummeted 20% to 32% after Reuters reported its shutdown on September 12, 2026, following a Houthi drone attack. This direct impact on the pipeline's operational status makes a swift restart highly improbable.
drivers: Reuters reported pipeline shutdown (Sept 12)
Houthi drone attack caused closure
Only 3 days for restart by Sept 15 deadline
en.why_matters: The East-West pipeline is critical for Saudi oil exports, especially as a workaround for the Strait of Hormuz, and its disruption could impact global oil supply and prices. This incident highlights escalating regional tensions and risks to energy infrastructure.
en.bull_case: Saudi Arabia could announce a rapid repair and restart timeline, potentially by September 15, to mitigate economic impact and show resilience.
en.bear_case: Damage from the drone attack or security concerns will likely prevent the pipeline from restarting by the tight September 15 deadline.
